final_answer:
The probability of getting exactly 7 heads when flipping a fair coin 10 times is calculated using the binomial probability formula. First, determine the number of ways to choose 7 successes (heads) out of 10 trials, which is given by the combination formula $ C(10, 7) $. This is calculated as:

$$
C(10, 7) = \frac{10!}{7!(10-7)!} = \frac{10!}{7!3!} = \frac{10 \times 9 \times 8}{3 \times 2 \times 1} = 120
$$

Next, multiply this by the probability of getting 7 heads and 3 tails, which for a fair coin is $ (0.5)^7 \times (0.5)^3 = (0.5)^{10} = \frac{1}{1024} $.

$$
P(7 \text{ heads}) = C(10, 7) \times (0.5)^{10} = 120 \times \frac{1}{1024} \approx 0.1172
$$

So, the probability of getting exactly 7 heads is approximately 0.1172 or 11.72%.
